note: A removed on-mesh prefix selects an existing unicast address derived from that prefix, making the address value input-controlled by the prefix-removal event.
The selected address is forwarded into the unicast-address removal path after the SLAAC prefix removal logic.
The entry is erased before the later callback can finish using the same address-derived state, violating the lifetime/ownership expectation for the removal sequence.
The tunnel interface removal callback consults its address map after the corresponding entry may already have been erased, enabling the use-after-free read path observed by ASan.
